meta.name: data-scientist
meta.description: Expert data processing specialist with intelligent DuckDB/Polars selection for maximum performance. Always includes numpy, never uses pandas, runs everything through uv. Triggers: 'analyze the data', 'analyze this file', 'what is in this CSV/parquet/json', 'summarize this', 'group by', 'filter rows', 'sort by', 'join these files', 'merge datasets', 'time series trend', 'last 30 days data', 'compare yesterday and today', 'distribution/histogram', 'correlation', 'clean duplicates', 'handle missing values', 'dataset larger than RAM', 'SQL query on files', 'DataFrame operations', 'chart/plot this data', DuckDB vs Polars selection, quick data exploration CLI. NOT for plain text/code inspection, configs, or tiny inline math.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析 CSV、Parquet 等数据文件,完成汇总、筛选与关联统计
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果面对数据文件想快速搞清规律和统计结果
copy.tagline_en: Analyze CSV, Parquet, and JSON files to summarize, filter, and join data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often work with data files and want quick insights without complex coding

howto.what: 处理数据文件（CSV、Parquet、JSON 等）时，Claude 会用 uv 运行 Python，并自动挑选 DuckDB 或 Polars 做查询、过滤、分组、排序、合并、画图等，返回处理结果。大文件也能应对；它不用 pandas，但一定会带上 numpy。
howto.when: 当你要求分析、总结、分组等数据处理操作，或提到 CSV、Parquet、JSON 等数据文件时触发；纯文本检查和简单小计算不触发。

say.text: 分析一下这个 CSV 文件，按类别汇总销售额
把这两个文件按客户 ID 合并，统计每位客户的总金额
say.note: 先用 DuckDB 做连接，再返回聚合结果。

say.text: 这个数据有重复行，帮我清理并统计缺失值
say.note: 会去重并给出缺失情况，Polars 适合这一步。

howto.what_en: Claude processes data files (CSV/Parquet/JSON) via uv-run Python, intelligently choosing DuckDB or Polars to query, filter, group, sort, join, or plot, returning results. Handles large datasets; never uses pandas, always includes numpy.
howto.when_en: When you ask to analyze, summarize, or group data, or mention data files like CSV, Parquet, or JSON. Plain-text checks and small inline calculations do not trigger it.

say_en.text: Analyze this CSV file and sum sales by category.
say_en.note: Claude picks DuckDB to group and sum, then reports time and row counts.

say_en.text: Join these two files on customer ID and total amounts per customer.
say_en.note: Uses DuckDB for the join, then returns the aggregated result.

say_en.text: This file has duplicates—clean it and report missing values.
say_en.note: Dedupes and summarizes missingness, likely with Polars.
